**Build SNP Lists to Filter AoU Summary Statistics by**
```{bash}
#!/bin/bash

#code adapted from https://github.com/idgregga7100/AoU_to_PrediXcan/tree/main

#make new directory
mkdir ~/aou_predixcan/mesa_gtex_ref

#open tar file
tar -xf ~/Data/predictdb_models/elastic-net-with-mesa.tar -C ~/

#directory to .db files
models=~/mesa_dbfiles/*.db

#.db to .csv
for model in ${models}
do
  echo ${model}
  #extract just the filename without path and extension
  basename=$(basename "${model}" .db)
  sqlite3 -header -csv "${model}" 'select * from weights;' > ~/aou_predixcan/mesa_gtex_ref/${basename}.csv
done

#merge the SNPs
Rscript ~/aou_predixcan/predixcan_format/01union_of_snps.R

#download full rsid file
wget https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/snp/organisms/human_9606_b151_GRCh38p7/VCF/All_20180418.vcf.gz

#unzip file
gunzip ~/All_20180418.vcf.gz

#remove meta data rows
awk '!/^##/' ~/All_20180418.vcf > ~/no_meta.vcf

#keep only rows that are also in predixcan_models_varids-effallele.txt
awk 'NR==FNR {split($1, parts, ":"); chr=parts[1]; position=parts[2]; gsub(/^chr/, "", chr); lookup[chr":"position]++; next} /^#/ {print; next} {chr_pos = $1":"$2; if (chr_pos in lookup) print}' ~/aou_predixcan/predixcan_models_varids-effallele.txt ~/aou_predixcan/no_meta.vcf > ~/aou_predixcan/filtered_no_meta.vcf

#keep only first 3 columns
cut -f1-3 ~/aou_predixcan/filtered_no_meta.vcf > ~/aou_predixcan/gtex_rsid_ref_w_header.vcf

#rename column headers
sed '1s/#CHROM\tPOS\tID/CHR\tPOS\trsID/' ~/aou_predixcan/gtex_rsid_ref_w_header.vcf > ~/aou_predixcan/gtex_rsid_ref.vcf

#rezip files
gzip ~/gtex_rsid_ref.vcf
gzip ~/All_20180418.vcf

#to send to All of Us bucket
gsutil -m cp -v ~/gtex_rsid_ref.vcf <paste_your_bucket_here>/data/
```

**01union_of_snps.R**
```{r}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

files <- list.files('~/aou_predixcan/mesa_gtex_ref', pattern = '.*\\.csv$')

#initialize dataframe
result <- data.frame(rsid = character(), chr = character(), pos = character(), rsid = character())

for(file in files) {
  cat(file, "\n")
  f <- fread(paste0('~/aou_predixcan/mesa_gtex_ref/', file))
  #extract chr and pos from rsid (format: chr10_78827_C_T_b38)
  chr_pos <- f %>%
    select(rsid, rsid) %>%
    unique() %>%
    mutate(
      chr = str_extract(rsid, "chr\\d+"),
      pos = str_extract(rsid, "(?<=chr\\d{1,2}_)\\d+")
    ) %>%
    select(rsid, chr, pos, rsid)
  
  #combine with result
  result <- rbind(result, chr_pos)
}

#remove duplicates and clean
nrow(result)
result <- unique(result)
nrow(result)
result <- result[!is.na(result$chr) & !is.na(result$pos) & result$rsid != "", ]
nrow(result)

#underscores to semicolons
result$rsid <- gsub("_", ":", result$rsid)

#remove _b38
result$rsid <- substr(result$rsid, 1, nchar(result$rsid) - 4)

#rename columns
colnames(result) <- c("varID", "chr", "pos")

#save result
fwrite(result, '~/aou_predixcan/predixcan_models_varids-effallele.txt', quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
```
